title: 第198章 一剑毙命第197章 我自己有多强
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
自己有多强？
当然，这句话是对混沌左丘辰说的，也是对他自己说的。
战胜自己的镜像，某种意义上就是战胜自己。
这既是雷劫的考验，也是一次难得的磨砺机会。
要知道，在与自己的极限对战中，往往能触摸到更高的境界...
此刻，混沌左丘辰没有回答。
因为，它的回答是一剑！
嗤！
瞬间，这一剑斩出的刹那，左丘辰的瞳孔猛然收缩。
因为这一剑他太熟悉了，三行归一，水火土三色剑罡！
但混沌左丘辰斩出的三行归一与他自己的完全不同。
因为，剑罡中除了水火土三种法则外，还融入了一缕混沌灭世雷的力量。
故此，三色剑罡在雷力的加持下变得更加狂暴，所过之处空间都被撕出了一道长长的黑色裂缝...
“玩雷劫你是行家！”
“但你玩剑，那就有点小儿科了！”
锵！
当下，左丘辰不退反进，直接祭出紫薇帝剑。
嗤！
一剑斩出，天地失色。
因为，同样是三行归一，但他这一剑中融入了慕容仙儿的无情道剑剑意...

而剑罡的锋锐在无情道剑的加持下提升了一个层次。
滋啦！
故此，那剑锋所过之处连空气都被切割成了肉眼可见的两半。
下一瞬，两道三色剑罡在半空中悍然相撞。
轰！
这一撞的动静比之前的所有雷劫加起来都要剧烈。
同时，九幽仙城上空像是炸开了一轮三色太阳。
只见，冰蓝、赤金、玄黄三种颜色的光芒混合着混沌色的雷光向四面八方爆发....
而一些靠得近的低阶妖兽直接被冲击波掀飞出去，在空中翻了十几个跟头才勉强稳住身形。
甚至，左丘辰握剑的手微微发麻。
因为刚才那一剑的对拼，他竟然落了下风。
主要原因是混沌左丘辰的剑罡中蕴含的雷力太霸道了...
content_en:
How strong are you?
Of course, this sentence was said to Chaos Zuo Qiuchen, and also to himself.
Defeating your own mirror image is, in a sense, defeating yourself.
This is not only a test of Thunder Tribulation, but also a rare opportunity to hone one's skills.
You know, in the extreme battle with yourself, you can often touch a higher realm...
At this moment, Chaos Zuo Qiuchen did not answer.
Because its answer is a sword!
laugh!
In an instant, the moment the sword was struck, Zuo Qiuchen's pupils suddenly shrank.
Because he was so familiar with this sword. The three elements were united into one, the three-color sword of water, fire, and earth!
But the Three Elements Guiyi that Chaos Zuo Qiuchen slashed was completely different from his own.
Because, in addition to the three laws of water, fire and earth, Jian Gang also incorporates the power of a chaotic world-destroying thunder.
Therefore, the three-color sword gang became more violent with the blessing of thunder, and a long black crack was torn out in the space wherever it passed...
"You are an expert at playing Thunder Tribulation!"
"But if you play with a sword, that's a bit childish!"
Clang!
At that moment, Zuo Qiuchen advanced instead of retreating and directly used the Ziwei Emperor Sword.
laugh!
With one slash of the sword, the sky and the earth were eclipsed.
Because, the three elements are also unified into one, but his sword incorporates Murong Xianer's ruthless sword sword intention...
And the sharpness of Jian Gang has been raised to a higher level with the blessing of Qing Wu Dao Sword.
Zhila!
Therefore, even the air where the sword edge passed was cut into two halves visible to the naked eye.
The next moment, two three-color swords collided violently in mid-air.
boom!
The noise of this collision was more violent than all the previous thunder disasters combined.
At the same time, a three-color sun seemed to explode over Jiuyou Fairy City.
I saw three colors of ice blue, red gold, and dark yellow light mixed with chaotic thunder exploding in all directions...
Some low-level monsters that were close to them were directly thrown away by the shock wave, and they turned over a dozen somersaults in the air before barely regaining their balance.
Even Zuo Qiuchen's hand holding the sword was slightly numb.
Because of the sword fight just now, he actually lost.
The main reason is that the thunder power contained in Chaos Zuo Qiuchen's sword is too overbearing...
